question: For each GREEN (deterministic=1) cell in compat-envelope/scorecard.csv, does the probe that certified it actually FAIL when a known-wrong behaviour is planted? At what tier can each cell honestly be certified?

binaries.dbi: worktrees/dbi/hermit/target/debug/hermit @ 52d56e5ce (run IN PLACE; copying the binary out of its worktree breaks DBI)

guests.mut_stdout: planted: stdout differs run-to-run (prints a monotonically growing counter)
guests.mut_detlog_only: planted: only a read() return LENGTH differs; stdout+exit byte-identical
guests.mut_addr: planted: only a pointer ARG to a zero-length write differs; stdout+exit byte-identical
guests.mut_path: planted: only an openat PATH arg differs; stdout+exit byte-identical

divergence_mechanism: each mutant appends one byte to /tmp/w7mutstate and reads the new size, so invocation A and invocation B are deterministically different by construction; verified natively before any hermit run

tiers.T-INFO: all INFO-level log lines, exact, after stripping only the wall-clock line prefix
tiers.T-INFO-DETLOG: INFO lines containing DETLOG, exact, after stripping only the wall-clock line prefix
tiers.T-DEBUG: all DEBUG-level lines, exact (this is what --verify-strict compares)

method_caveat: tier measurements use TWO SEPARATE hermit invocations rather than hermit's internal --verify double-run, because --verify intermittently hits the known slow-drain (a clean_ctrl --verify-strict run exceeded 900s after completing twice in <240s). Cross-checked on clean_ctrl/ptrace: internal double-run gave INFO 56|56 0 divergent, DEBUG 217|217 14 divergent; separate invocations gave INFO 56|56 0 divergent, DEBUG 217|217 17 divergent. INFO tier agrees exactly.
